descriptions.Title: Memory
descriptions.Help: Automatic mode stores a private encryption key in Steward’s local credential files. Custom mode uses your existing 32-byte key reference. Keep the original key for existing memories and backups.

descriptions.Title: Semantic search
descriptions.Description: Choose how Memory finds relevant information.
descriptions.Help: Automatic mode uses local text search without a service. Custom mode connects your embedding model; encrypted memory requires a literal loopback endpoint. Changing an existing vector identity requires an offline index rebuild.
descriptions.Example:
provider: openai_compatible
endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
model: nomic-embed-text
dimensions: 768

descriptions.Title: MCP tools
descriptions.Description: Connect allowlisted tools from isolated local stdio providers.
descriptions.Help: Use absolute executable and private state paths. Testing starts the configured providers in the existing kernel sandbox and checks tool discovery; it never invokes an advertised tool. MCP tools always run through Code Mode; no exposure modes or per-tool exposure settings are needed. Credentials in command arguments are not supported.
descriptions.Example:
- name: local_catalog
  command: /absolute/path/to/mcp-server
  args: []
  directory: /private/steward-mcp
  tools: {lookup: read_only}

descriptions.Title: Skills
descriptions.Description: Discover curated, versioned methods and their resources.
descriptions.Help: Prepare the catalog outside application data and execution workspaces. Testing validates the actual catalog and its bounded resources. An empty valid catalog is allowed.

descriptions.Title: Files and commands
descriptions.Description: Read, edit, write and run commands in a private isolated workspace.
descriptions.Help: Use a separate private directory and optional read-only toolchains. Testing creates the workspace if needed and runs only a fixed diagnostic command in the kernel sandbox. Disable Computer first to select this backend. An empty setting restores the default local workspace.

descriptions.Title: Computer
descriptions.Description: Use a private macOS desktop, prepared automatically on first use.
descriptions.Help: Automatic mode downloads and prepares a private macOS desktop on first use on Apple silicon. Custom mode connects your provisioned Lume store and sealed base. Custom testing checks the control plane without booting a VM.
descriptions.Example:
computer:
  root: /absolute/private/computer-store
  endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:7777
  compatibility:
    provider_version: '0.6.1'
    guest_build: YOUR_BUILD
    driver_version: YOUR_DRIVER_VERSION
    driver_sha256: YOUR_DRIVER_SHA256
    driver_team: YOUR_DRIVER_TEAM
    driver_bundle: com.trycua.driver
    architecture: arm64
  guest:
    user: lume
    port: 22
    password_ref: env:STEWARD_GUEST_PASSWORD
    host_key_sha256: SHA256:YOUR_PINNED_HOST_KEY
  manifest:
    version: 1
javascript:
  command: /absolute/path/to/node
  script: /absolute/path/to/runtime/javascript/src/sidecar.mjs

copy.Automatic: Steward manages the default. You can choose custom settings or turn it off.
copy.MemoryKeyUnavailable: The saved Memory key is unavailable in local credential files. Restore the original key before restarting. Existing keys are never replaced.
copy.ExecutionManaged: Files and commands use the Computer workspace. Open Computer to verify its connection.
copy.VerificationExpired: Verification expired. Test this candidate again before saving.
copy.ProbeAutomatic: Steward will manage this capability automatically. Save and restart to apply the default.
copy.ProbeExecutionConflict: File tools use Computer. Configure and test that backend instead.
copy.ProbeDisabled: This candidate disables the capability. Save and restart to apply it; existing work keeps its original capabilities.
copy.ProbeMemoryFailed: Memory key unavailable. Provide the referenced 32-byte key in SecretStore or the process environment.
copy.ProbeMemoryReady: The referenced 32-byte encryption key is available. No memory was read or written.
copy.ProbeEmbeddingFailed: Embedding connection failed. Check the endpoint, model, dimensions and credential reference; redirects and invalid vectors are rejected.
copy.ProbeEmbeddingReady: Embedding endpoint returned a valid {{dimensions}}-dimensional vector for a fixed diagnostic sentence.
copy.ProbeSkillsFailed: Skill catalog unavailable. Prepare a readable catalog with valid SKILL.md files and bounded resources at the configured root.
copy.ProbeSkillsReady: The actual Skill catalog and its resources passed validation ({{tools}} discovery/read tools).
copy.ProbeMCPFailed: MCP discovery failed. Check absolute executable/private directory paths, the kernel sandbox, protocol and allowlisted tool names.
copy.ProbeMCPReady: {{providers}} isolated provider(s) advertised {{tools}} allowed tools. No advertised tool was invoked.
copy.ProbeExecutionFailed: Workspace diagnostic failed. Check private directory permissions, Python 3, bash, kernel sandbox permissions and read-only toolchain paths.
copy.ProbeExecutionInvalid: The isolated diagnostic command did not complete successfully.
copy.ProbeExecutionReady: A fixed diagnostic command completed in the configured kernel sandbox. No user command or network access was used.
copy.ProbeJavaScriptMissing: Computer requires the JavaScript runtime configuration.
copy.ProbeJavaScriptFailed: JavaScript runtime unavailable. Check the absolute Node/sidecar paths and install the pinned runtime dependencies.
copy.ProbeComputerStoreFailed: Computer store unavailable. Provision the private Lume store and sealed base before testing.
copy.ProbeComputerFailed: Computer connection failed. Check the Lume endpoint/version, sealed base compatibility/integrity and Guest credential reference. The diagnostic does not boot or modify a VM.
copy.ProbeComputerReady: Lume version, sealed base and credential availability verified. Guest runtime identity is checked when a Run first opens its Computer.
